brief.text:
SITUATION NOW
Indonesian wildfires threaten critically-endangered orangutans, according to the IUCN. [1]

WHAT THIS MEANS FOR INDONESIA
The threat to critically-endangered orangutans from wildfires highlights environmental risks in Indonesia, which is a net energy exporter with a net energy import dependency of -90%. [1][E3]

KEY RISKS
Indonesia's link to 25 US OFAC and Canada SEMA sanctions designations poses a risk to its international financial dealings. [E2]

OUTLOOK
A Polymarket market on Israel and Indonesia normalizing relations by December 31, 2026 is priced at 9% as of Sep 28, 2026, closing Jan 1, 2027. [E6]

WATCH ITEMS
It is unresolved whether the plan to save Bali's lost fireflies will succeed. [5]

evidence.label: US OFAC and Canada SEMA designations
evidence.factText: Indonesia is linked to 25 US OFAC and Canada SEMA sanctions designations, as of Sep 28, 2026.

evidence.label: Net energy import dependency
evidence.factText: Indonesia has a net energy import dependency of -90% (World Bank Open Data, 2023); a negative value means Indonesia is a net energy exporter.

evidence.label: Polymarket prediction market
evidence.factText: A Polymarket market related to Indonesia, "Israel and Indonesia normalize relations by December 31, 2026?", priced Yes at 9% on Sep 28, 2026; it closes Jan 1, 2027.
